pairs: vidit eos qui mittebant munera sua in gazophylacium, divites.
he saw the wealthy putting their donations into the offertory.
Vidit autem et quamdam viduam pauperculam mittentem æra minuta duo.
Then he also saw a certain widow, a pauper, putting in two small brass coins.
quia vidua hæc pauper plus quam omnes misit.
that this poor widow has put in more than all the others.
Nam omnes hi ex abundanti sibi miserunt in munera Dei:
For all these, out of their abundance, have added to the gifts for God.
hæc autem ex eo quod deest illi,
But she, out of what she needed,
omnem victum suum quem habuit, misit.
has put in all that she had to live on.”
Et quibusdam dicentibus de templo quod bonis lapidibus et donis ornatum esset,
And when some of them were saying, about the temple, that it was adorned with excellent stones and gifts,
venient dies in quibus non relinquetur lapis super lapidem,
the days will arrive when there will not be left behind stone upon stone,
et quod signum cum fieri incipient?
And what will be the sign when these things will happen?”
multi enim venient in nomine meo,
For many will come in my name,
‘The time has drawn near.’ And so,
do not choose to go after them.
Cum autem audieritis prælia et seditiones,
And when you will have heard of battles and seditions,
But the end is not so soon.”
Et terræmotus magni erunt per loca,
And there will be great earthquakes in various places,
and there will be great signs.
Sed ante hæc omnia injicient vobis manus suas,
they will lay their hands on you and persecute you,
handing you over to synagogues and into custody,
dragging you before kings and governors,
And this will be an opportunity for you to give testimony.
Ponite ergo in cordibus vestris non præmeditari quemadmodum respondeatis:
Therefore, set this in your hearts: that you should not consider in advance how you might respond.
ego enim dabo vobis os et sapientiam,
For I will give to you a mouth and wisdom,
cui non poterunt resistere et contradicere omnes adversarii vestri.
which all your adversaries will not be able to resist or contradict.
And you will be handed over by your parents,
And they will bring about the death of some of you.
et eritis odio omnibus propter nomen meum:
And you will be hated by all because of my name.
et capillus de capite vestro non peribit.
And yet, not a hair of your head will perish.
In patientia vestra possidebitis animas vestras.
By your patience, you shall possess your souls.
Cum autem videritis circumdari ab exercitu Jerusalem,
Then, when you will have seen Jerusalem encircled by an army,
tunc scitote quia appropinquavit desolatio ejus:
know then that its desolation has drawn near.
tunc qui in Judæa sunt, fugiant ad montes,
Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,
et qui in medio ejus, discedant:
and those who are in its midst withdraw,
et qui in regionibus, non intrent in eam,
and those who are in the countryside not enter into it.
For these are the days of retribution,
ut impleantur omnia quæ scripta sunt.
so that all things may be fulfilled, which have been written.
Væ autem prægnantibus et nutrientibus in illis diebus!
Then woe to those who are pregnant or nursing in those days.
erit enim pressura magna super terram, et ira populo huic.
For there will be great distress upon the land and great wrath upon this people.
And they will fall by the edge of the sword.
et captivi ducentur in omnes gentes,
And they will be led away as captives into all nations.
And Jerusalem will be trampled by the Gentiles,
until the times of the nations are fulfilled.
And there will be signs in the sun and the moon and the stars.
et in terris pressura gentium præ confusione sonitus maris,
out of confusion at the roaring of the sea and of the waves:
arescentibus hominibus præ timore, et exspectatione, quæ supervenient universo orbi:
men withering away out of fear and out of apprehension over the things that will overwhelm the whole world.
For the powers of the heavens will be moved.
et tunc videbunt Filium hominis venientem in nube cum potestate magna
And then they will see the Son of man coming on a cloud,
But when these things begin to happen,
And he told them a comparison:
cum producunt jam ex se fructum,
When presently they produce fruit from themselves,
you know that summer is near.
et vos cum videritis hæc fieri,
when you will have seen these things happen,
scitote quoniam prope est regnum Dei.
know that the kingdom of God is near.
this lineage shall not pass away,
Heaven and earth shall pass away.
But my words shall not pass away.
ne forte graventur corda vestra in crapula,
lest perhaps your hearts may be weighed down by self-indulgence
and the cares of this life.
et superveniat in vos repentina dies illa:
And then that day may overwhelm you suddenly.
tamquam laqueus enim superveniet in omnes qui sedent super faciem omnis terræ.
For like a snare it will overwhelm all those who sit upon the face of the entire earth.
ut digni habeamini fugere ista omnia quæ futura sunt,
so that you may be held worthy to escape from all these things, which are in the future,
and to stand before the Son of man.”
Erat autem diebus docens in templo:
Now in the daytime, he was teaching in the temple.
But truly, departing in the evening,
morabatur in monte qui vocatur Oliveti.
he lodged on the mount that is called Olivet.
Et omnis populus manicabat ad eum in templo audire eum.
And all the people arrived in the morning to listen to him in the temple.
